vehicles.title: Per-vehicle performance

insight.noVehicles: You have no vehicles in the selected period. Add a vehicle and complete listing approval to start receiving bookings.

details.backendRequired: A backend update is needed to view per-vehicle records.

disputes.title: Vehicle disputes
disputes.description: Records created in the selected period. Statuses shown are current; the record count may exceed the number of disputed trips.

history.title: Booking history
history.description: Requests created in the period, including cancelled and rejected bookings. Totals are booking value, not owner income.
history.empty: No booking requests created in the period.

header.title: Availability notifications
header.description: Track the rental windows you want. MoveVN notifies you in the app when the vehicle has an available schedule; you still need to check and book the vehicle.
